readback_body:
## Requirements: independent trusted Pages Acceptance source checkout

**Companion:** #1923, parent #1906/#1782. This is a dedicated trusted-workflow activation PR required by `.github/AGENTS.md` and `nession-cicd`. The separate Pages application/parser lives in a different PR. No product `web/` changes.

### Scope
- In `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml` only, add `actions/checkout@v4` read-only `acceptance-results` orphan checkout with `persist-credentials:false` and dedicated `acceptance-store` path, strictly in the trusted main-only Pages build.
- Pin `ACCEPTANCE_RESULTS_SHA` to actual Git HEAD and pass `ACCEPTANCE_RESULTS_DIR` to the existing standalone Pages build, verifying exported metadata matches the pinned ref.
- No browser token, no permission escalation, no additional orphan writer, no routing to product `web/`, no staging feature coupling. Same Pages deployment integrity, digest and anonymous HTTPS checks stay intact.
- This workflow PR is main-based and merged with merge-commit, not squash/rebase. Deploy may require the companion main PR to be present before running source-reader validation.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Trusted main-only workflow checks out read-only pinned canonical Acceptance Store and binds exact source HEAD without exposing privileged browser data.
- [x] SC-02 Workflow review/security fixtures preserve deployment permissions, independent Pages/Web isolation, pinned artifact and public HTTPS integrity checks; exact PR HEAD gates pass.
- [x] SC-03 Exact PR HEAD Quality, Case Smoke and selected E2E have independently authenticated successful workflow evidence; the separate feature PR #1929 owns Pages CI (the workflow-only PR does not match Pages CI path filters). Read-only Agent acceptance and final acceptance-pr-gate remain external merge controls, not self-referential SC evidence.
